purpose: Pinned source inventory for the device-configurator specification; not a production adapter or an implementation claim
scope: All native circuit-control behavior classes, inherited writable fields, equivalent collection operations, and constant-combinator manual sections

type.variant_parameter_description: Other attributes may be specified depending on `operation`:

guest_normalization.object_references: Never expose LuaObjects. Prototype identity unions accept prototype-name strings only; concepts containing objects require an explicit plain-data adapter before release.
guest_normalization.enums: Guest enum values use names from enum_values, never engine numeric ordinals.
guest_normalization.optional_reads: Report present/unset/unsupported separately through configuration snapshots.
guest_normalization.fulfilled: Read-only evaluated condition output; rejected in writes.
guest_normalization.shared_sections: Manual-only edits; shared-group contents outside the target authority are refused. Explicitly detach to local settings before editing.
guest_normalization.method_equivalence: Decider parameter operations and display-message methods are covered by validated complete parameters/messages replacement. Circuit reads are not configuration setters.
